ritual1962.title: 1962 General Rubrics of the Roman Missal, nn. 477, 507, 513-516
ritual1962.fact: In Sung Mass Dominus vobiscum is sung whenever it occurs (except preparatory Confiteor versicles); Offertory and dismissal both contain an Et cum spiritu tuo response.

dismissalPerformance.title: B. Andrew Mills, Psallite Sapienter, 2008, paragraph 75, p.29
dismissalPerformance.fact: A further Dominus vobiscum and response follows Postcommunion and precedes sung dismissal
